credits_value: Up to $200,000 in Activate Credits; self-serve Founders tier: "Start with $1,000 USD in Activate Credits. Select participants may qualify for additional credits up to $5,000"; Portfolio tier "Up to $200,000" with an Activate Provider Org ID; "AWS Credits for AI Startups" $200,000+ invite-only
cash_value: USD credits only, not cash; AI-startup tier $200,000+ invite only
eligibility_india_solo: Yes. Eligibility is stage/age based, no country list: "Pre-series B, founded in the last 10 years, AWS Account on Paid Tier Plan, and either new to Activate Credits or requesting more credits than previously received". Solo/self-funded uses Founders tier with no investor needed.
product_required: Not stated as a requirement; application asks for "details about your product, funding stage, and company profile"
what_unlocks_approval: Self-funded path: complete Builder ID + company profile + link AWS account. Portfolio tier needs an Org ID from an Activate Provider (accelerator/angel/VC).
timeline: 5-10 business days ("You'll hear back within 5-10 business days")
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. Cheapest real cloud credit for a solo founder: $1,000 guaranteed on the self-funded tier, no referrer. The $200k headline is partner-gated. Also lists Kiro Startup Credits for startups without Activate credits.

credits_value: Start tier: "Up to $2,000 USD in Google Cloud credits, valid for one year"; funded Scale tier: "Up to $200,000 USD in Google Cloud (up to $350,000 USD for AI startups)" - Year 1 100% up to $100,000 ($250,000 AI-first), Year 2 20% up to $100,000
cash_value: Credits plus $200 Google Skills credits (Start) or $500 (Scale); 12 months Google Workspace Business Plus; $600/month Maps credits on funded tiers
eligibility_india_solo: Yes, pre-funding. Start tier: "Founded within the last 24 months", "Not yet received Google Cloud credits (beyond the trial)", "Technology startup planning to seek venture funding soon". Country rule is a region test, not a ban: "Customers must be located in a region where Google Cloud is available in GA, and available through self-service purchasing". India is not named as excluded.
product_required: Yes. Start tier is "For digital-native startups with a working MVP, a clear business model".
what_unlocks_approval: Working MVP + roadmap + intent to raise. Review weighs "funding stage, funding type, business model, founder experience, and product usage".
timeline: Not published. Page only says Google will email if more information is needed.
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. Best self-serve AI credit for a live-MVP solo founder: $2,000 now, and the same application is the on-ramp to $200k-$350k once a round closes. Keep the GCP account free of paid credits before applying.

credits_value: "Access up to $150K USD in Startup credits"; program page: "unlock up to $5,000 in Startup credits through business verification" then "up to $150,000 in Startup credits over time". Apply page detail: $200 starter credits without an investor code, $1,000 with one.
eligibility_india_solo: Yes. "Be headquartered in a country where Azure services are available"; "Not have raised Series C funding or later"; "Not have received more than $350,000 in lifetime free Azure credits". No revenue or accelerator requirement, and "you can apply whether you're just getting started or already using another cloud".
product_required: No. "Working toward or already at MVP" is the bar; website is listed as "if available".
what_unlocks_approval: Verification of the business (registered name matching legal docs, LinkedIn identity check). An investor referral code is optional and only raises the tier: "You can still apply by selecting Continue without a code".
timeline: "Microsoft reviews your application within three business days"; starter credits available immediately
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. Fastest big-vendor yes, but the self-serve number is small ($200-$1,000); $150k needs usage growth and business verification. Use personal Microsoft account, not a company-domain login.

credits_value: not published. Page: "Unlock credits and dedicated support through eligible VC partners"; FAQ: "Please reach out to your VC to learn how to unlock OpenAI API credits." No self-serve tier and no dollar figure on the page.
eligibility_india_solo: Not a country question - access is partner-gated. Named partner VCs include "Thrive Capital, Sequoia, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, and Conviction Partners". An unfunded India solo founder has no published path.
product_required: Not stated. Credits application asks for org ID and "Basic funding details".
what_unlocks_approval: Being a portfolio company of a VC in OpenAI's partner network, or attending an event/hackathon where credits are issued.
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. No self-serve application and no published amount; effectively closed to a pre-revenue founder without a US VC. Revisit after a round.

credits_value: not published for the core program. Partner stack: "Access discounts and credits worth up to $45,000 from companies building with Claude." VC path: "You may be eligible to receive up to $100K in additional API credits, claimed through your VC."
cash_value: Partner offers worth up to $45,000 (third-party tools), not cash
eligibility_india_solo: Program is closed regardless of country: "Our current cohort is now full, and we're not accepting new applications right now." The $100K API credit path is only for companies "backed by a VC in Anthropic's partner network".
product_required: Not stated; implied by "early-stage founders building on Claude"
what_unlocks_approval: Cohort admission when open; otherwise a partner-network VC. Credits are first-party only: "They can't be used on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or other third-party platforms."
timeline: Not applicable - applications closed as of 2026-11-26
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. Closed to new applicants, and the only open credit route ($100K) needs a partner VC. Worth a newsletter signup, not a week-one action.

credits_value: 33,000,000 characters on the Scale plan for 12 months: "That's over 680 hours of Agents usage. More than $5,500+ in value."
cash_value: $5,500+ stated value; no cash alternative ("Can I resell or exchange my grants for cash" is a FAQ)
eligibility_india_solo: Yes, country-agnostic and funding-agnostic. Only size rule: "open to all startups or companies with less than 25 employees at the time of receiving the application"; "Agencies, consulting firms and SMBs are not eligible"; one application per company.
product_required: Effectively yes - you must describe the product you are building and how you will grow; there is no revenue bar.
what_unlocks_approval: A credible product use case for voice plus the application form. Paying self-serve customers are eligible; existing enterprise deals are not.
timeline: "We'll let you know if your application is accepted within one week."
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. Easiest one-week yes of the AI vendors and worth taking, but only useful if the people-graph product actually speaks (voice intros, call notes, agent calls).

credits_value: "up to $30,000 in Flexible Commitment Amount, Enterprise-tier access, and startup-focused support"
eligibility_india_solo: Not published. The page names no funding cap, company age or country rule; it only says "eligible teams" and offers "Contact the Startups Team" - there is no self-serve application form and no published eligibility test.
what_unlocks_approval: Not published. The only route shown is the interest/contact form and the partner network ("Backed by the best startup partners"); third-party write-ups say an approved partner is required, but that is not on Vercel's page.
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. $30k headline but eligibility is hidden behind a contact form and partner network; treat as a referral play, not a week-one application.

credits_value: Tier 3: "$10k" - "Get started with $10k in credits to build and launch your product, no minimum funding required." Tier 2: "$100k" (under $5M raised, partner-funded). Tier 1: "$350k" ($5M+ raised, partner-funded).
cash_value: USD credits for 1 year; R2 capped at $10,000, Workers AI capped at $2,500 (Tier 3)
eligibility_india_solo: Yes, ideal. Tier 3 criteria: "Bootstrapped or self-funded", "Under $1M raised", "no minimum funding required". Country not restricted. Requirements: "Actively developing a technology product", "Has a valid, publicly accessible website", "Active on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), or GitHub".
product_required: Yes - "Your startup has a live website we can verify". Ankit's live MVP clears this.
what_unlocks_approval: Live site + public social/GitHub presence + a product description. No deck, no referrer, no investor.
timeline: "Our review process typically takes up to 48 hours."
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. Best ratio of speed to size for this founder: $10k, 48 hours, bootstrapped-friendly, and the live MVP website is the main gate. One-time per startup.

credits_value: "Accepted startups receive up to $15,000 in MongoDB Atlas credits. The amount depends on the startup's stage and investment partner, such as a VC or accelerator."
cash_value: USD Atlas credits; promo code must be activated within 30 days
eligibility_india_solo: Yes. "7 years old or younger", "Series B or earlier", "Building a single software product (agencies and dev shops aren't eligible)", "Has an active company website and LinkedIn profile". No country restriction and bootstrapped is an allowed funding stage on the form.
product_required: Yes - "Has an active company website and LinkedIn profile".
what_unlocks_approval: A single product, company website, LinkedIn page, and a funding stage. New and existing Atlas users both accepted.
timeline: "If you haven't heard back within five business days, contact startups@mongodb.com"
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. $15k with a 5-day clock and no investor needed - the best database credit here, but only worth it if the product actually sits on Atlas.

credits_value: $300 in Supabase credits. The former startup page (supabase.com/startups) now redirects to a product page with no application, amount or eligibility. No self-serve startup credit tier exists.
eligibility_india_solo: No. "Be a VC-backed startup with less than $5M in total funding" plus "Have an active AWS account". A bootstrapped India founder fails the VC-backed test; the only other route is a partner (YC/accelerator/VC) deal with unpublished terms.
product_required: Not stated for the AWS offer; you need an AWS account (i.e. the AWS Activate path).
what_unlocks_approval: Being VC-backed and arriving through AWS Activate; otherwise a Supabase accelerator/VC partner.
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. Effectively no program for this founder: $300, VC-backed only, and the main /startups URL is now a marketing page. Use the free tier instead.

credits_value: "6 months free with Notion AI included" (partner-affiliated, under 100 employees); "3 months free" (valid business website + company domain email, under 100 employees); "1 month free" for under-10-employee SMBs. FAQ: "a maximum of $12,000 for 100 employees" at "$20 per member paid annually".
cash_value: Up to $12,000 list value at 100 seats; for a solo founder the value is roughly one to three seats x $20/month
eligibility_india_solo: Yes, but the solo case is penalised: FAQ says "You have under 10 employees - SMBs with fewer than 10 employees receive our 1 month trial offer", and the 3/6-month tiers are "designed specifically for startups building scalable tech-related products". No country restriction.
product_required: Yes for the 3-month tier - a working business website and company-domain email; "inactive or incomplete website" downgrades you to 1 month.
what_unlocks_approval: A verifiable startup website and company domain email; 6 months needs a Notion partner (VC/accelerator).
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. A solo founder with a company domain likely lands the 3-month tier, not 6; small money, take it only if the team already lives in Notion.

credits_value: "$2.5K in Stripe product credits", "More than $200K in partner offers", and "$500 when you incorporate and open a Stripe Treasury bank account within 7 days". Stripe Startups (venture-backed program, credits against Stripe fees) also exists but publishes no amount.
cash_value: $2,500 Stripe credits + $500 Treasury deposit + $200K+ partner offers (AWS, Google, OpenRouter named); costs $500 to incorporate
eligibility_india_solo: Yes for Atlas: "Founders from anywhere in the world can use Atlas to form a US company in Delaware, and you don't need to be a US citizen or resident." This creates a US entity rather than crediting an Indian one. Stripe Startups is explicitly for "venture-backed startups".
product_required: No - Atlas is incorporation, not a product grant.
what_unlocks_approval: Paying the $500 fee and completing the online application. Atlas files in Delaware; no review board.
timeline: "most companies are incorporated within one business day"; tax ID "one to two business days" with US SSN/address/phone, otherwise "several weeks"
notes: Seen 2026-11-26. Not a credit program in the AWS sense: $500 out, ~$3,000 in credits plus partner offers and a Delaware C-corp that unlocks US payment rails and future US fundraising. Do it when a US customer or investor needs it.
